reference_answer_new: Yes. COM_ARM_WO_GPS controls this and defaults to 1 (Enabled): arming is allowed without GPS/a global position estimate, for flight modes that do not require position. Set it to 0 to require a valid EKF global position before arming.

reference_answer_new: Start QGroundControl, open Vehicle Setup > Firmware, then connect the flight controller directly to a powered USB port on the computer (not via a hub). Select 'PX4 Pro Stable Release vX.x.x' (autodetected for your board) and click OK; QGC downloads and flashes the firmware, then the board reboots and reconnects.
